paragraphs.source_en:
Lesson 2. Notes

Notes are the building blocks of music. A note’s length (duration) is measured in beats.

Whole notes last for four beats, which is a whole measure in 4 meter. The symbol for a whole note is an open notehead.

2 On track 2, the piano plays whole notes and the metronome (click track) plays every beat. Listen carefully to hear both instruments.

Half notes last for half as long as whole notes: two beats in 4 time. Their symbol is an open notehead with a vertical line called a stem. Stem

Open Notehead

3 On track 3, the piano plays half notes and the metronome plays every beat.

Quarter notes last for a quarter of a whole note: one beat. Their symbol is a closed notehead with a stem. Stem

Closed Notehead

4 On track 4, the piano and the metronome play quarter notes, that is, every beat together.
